posts.title: The Giant's Dollhouse
posts.description: It is in a room in a giant's manor house. It is a mock house with two stories and six rooms total. Each story is 7ft from floor to ceiling. There is one stairway to the second floor. Strange figures dressed in human robes do chores and carry out domestic tasks repeatedly. The figures never speak and wear painted wooden masks which imitate the faces of humans. A bird cage hangs from the true ceilin

posts.title: Politics in the Merish Empire
posts.description: Alignments in the Merish Empire are political. All members of a company must be within 1 alignment step of their company's leader. Preservationists (P) - Believe that the Emperor's current ways are perfect and must be preserved at all costs. Neutralists (N) - Have no political ideology but tend to align with Preservationists.
